Output/Application_Octetstream_Download..name: Download
Output/Application_Octetstream_Download..description: Displays a link to download the binary data of the column. You can use the first option to specify the filename, or use the second option as the name of a column which contains the filename. If you use the second option, you need to set the first option to the empty string.

Output/Application_Octetstream_Hex.php.name: Hex
Output/Application_Octetstream_Hex.php.description: Displays hexadecimal representation of data. Optional first parameter specifies how often space will be added (defaults to 2 nibbles).

Output/Image_JPEG_Inline.php.name: Inline
Output/Image_JPEG_Inline.php.description: Displays a clickable thumbnail. The options are the maximum width and height in pixels. The original aspect ratio is preserved.

Output/Image_JPEG_Link.php.name: ImageLink
Output/Image_JPEG_Link.php.description: Displays a link to download this image.

Output/Image_PNG_Inline.php.name: Inline
Output/Image_PNG_Inline.php.description: Displays a clickable thumbnail. The options are the maximum width and height in pixels. The original aspect ratio is preserved.

Output/Text_Octetstream_Sql.php.name: SQL
Output/Text_Octetstream_Sql.php.description: Formats text as SQL query with syntax highlighting.

Output/Text_Plain_Binarytoip.php.name: Binary To IPv4/IPv6
Output/Text_Plain_Binarytoip.php.description: Converts an Internet network address stored as a binary string into a string in Internet standard (IPv4/IPv6) format.

Output/Text_Plain_Bool2Text.php.name: Bool2Text
Output/Text_Plain_Bool2Text.php.description: Converts Boolean values to text (default 'T' and 'F'). First option is for TRUE, second for FALSE. Nonzero=true.

Output/Text_Plain_Dateformat.php.name: Date Format
Output/Text_Plain_Dateformat.php.description: Displays a TIME, TIMESTAMP, DATETIME or numeric unix timestamp column as formatted date. The first option is the offset (in hours) which will be added to the timestamp (Default: 0). Use second option to specify a different date/time format string. Third option determines whether you want to see local date or UTC one (use "local" or "utc" strings) for that. According to that, date format has different value - for "local" see the documentation for PHP's strftime() function and for "utc" it is done using gmdate() function.

Output/Text_Plain_External.php.name: External
Output/Text_Plain_External.php.description: LINUX ONLY: Launches an external application and feeds it the column data via standard input. Returns the standard output of the application. The default is Tidy, to pretty-print HTML code. For security reasons, you have to manually edit the file libraries/classes/Plugins/Transformations/Abs/ExternalTransformationsPlugin.php and list the tools you want to make available. The first option is then the number of the program you want to use. The second option should be blank for historical reasons. The third option, if set to 1, will convert the output using htmlspecialchars() (Default 1). The fourth option, if set to 1, will prevent wrapping and ensure that the output appears all on one line (Default 1).

Output/Text_Plain_Formatted.php.name: Formatted
Output/Text_Plain_Formatted.php.description: Displays the contents of the column as-is, without running it through htmlspecialchars(). That is, the column is assumed to contain valid HTML.

Output/Text_Plain_Imagelink.php.name: Image Link
Output/Text_Plain_Imagelink.php.description: Displays an image and a link; the column contains the filename. The first option is a URL prefix like "https://www.example.com/". The second and third options are the width and the height in pixels.

Output/Text_Plain_Json.php.name: JSON
Output/Text_Plain_Json.php.description: Formats text as JSON with syntax highlighting.

Output/Text_Plain_Sql.php.name: SQL
Output/Text_Plain_Sql.php.description: Formats text as SQL query with syntax highlighting.

Output/Text_Plain_Xml.php.name: XML
Output/Text_Plain_Xml.php.description: Formats text as XML with syntax highlighting.

Text_Plain_Link.php.name: TextLink
Text_Plain_Link.php.description: Displays a link; the column contains the filename. The first option is a URL prefix like "https://www.example.com/". The second option is a title for the link.

Text_Plain_Longtoipv4.php.name: Long To IPv4
Text_Plain_Longtoipv4.php.description: Converts an (IPv4) Internet network address stored as a BIGINT into a string in Internet standard dotted format.

Text_Plain_PreApPend.php.name: PreApPend
Text_Plain_PreApPend.php.description: Prepends and/or Appends text to a string. First option is text to be prepended, second is appended (enclosed in single quotes, default empty string).

Text_Plain_Substring.php.name: Substring
Text_Plain_Substring.php.description: Displays a part of a string. The first option is the number of characters to skip from the beginning of the string (Default 0). The second option is the number of characters to return (Default: until end of string). The third option is the string to append and/or prepend when truncation occurs (Default: "…").

Input/Image_JPEG_Upload.php.name: Image upload
Input/Image_JPEG_Upload.php.description: Image upload functionality which also displays a thumbnail. The options are the width and height of the thumbnail in pixels. Defaults to 100 X 100.

Input/Text_Plain_FileUpload.php.name: Text file upload
Input/Text_Plain_FileUpload.php.description: File upload functionality for TEXT columns. It does not have a textarea for input.

Input/Text_Plain_Iptobinary.php.name: IPv4/IPv6 To Binary
Input/Text_Plain_Iptobinary.php.description: Converts an Internet network address in (IPv4/IPv6) format to binary

Input/Text_Plain_Iptolong.php.name: IPv4/IPv6 To Long
Input/Text_Plain_Iptolong.php.description: Converts an Internet network address in (IPv4/IPv6) format into a long integer.

Input/Text_Plain_JsonEditor.php.name: JSON
Input/Text_Plain_JsonEditor.php.description: Syntax highlighted CodeMirror editor for JSON.

Input/Text_Plain_RegexValidation.php.name: Regex Validation
Input/Text_Plain_RegexValidation.php.description: Validates the string using regular expression and performs insert only if string matches it. The first option is the Regular Expression.

Input/Text_Plain_SqlEditor.php.name: SQL
Input/Text_Plain_SqlEditor.php.description: Syntax highlighted CodeMirror editor for SQL.

Input/Text_Plain_XmlEditor.php.name: XML
Input/Text_Plain_XmlEditor.php.description: Syntax highlighted CodeMirror editor for XML (and HTML).
